card.title: Order of Business
card.instruction: Carry yourself as the person who decides what happens in what order. Redirect every interruption into the approved sequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wedding speeches go father, mother, best man, bride.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The bride needs to say the groom hasn't arrived.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That information belongs in her speech.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's asked me to announce it now. The guests are leaving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Father introduces mother, mother introduces best man, best man introduces you as the bride's spokesperson. No anecdotes; we can get there in thirty seconds.

mechanism: A treats the wedding speaking order as controlling even an urgent missing-groom announcement and compresses the sequence rather than skipping it.
confusable: Unlike blocking progress indefinitely, A may solve the interruption while preserving the approved order of who speaks.
comparison: The wedding alternative creates a thirty-second relay through the listed speakers; the fire alternative routes urgency through meeting minutes.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
